Name: Label Chest
Author: adyingdeath
Description:
[size=2]This mod supports [b]PC (mouse/controller) and Android[/b].[/size]

Tired of opening every single chest just to find where you put your items?
Label Chest is a simple but powerful quality-of-life mod designed to help you organize your farm. It lets you assign a custom label to any chest. This label then appears as floating text, without affecting the game’s balance.

[size=6]Features[/size][list]
[*]Easy Labeling: Adds a "Set Label" button directly inside the chest UI.
[*]In-World Display: See your chest names at a glance without opening them. The text is rendered in a clean, vanilla-friendly style above each chest.
[*]Smart Wrapping: Long labels are automatically wrapped to ensure they remain readable.
[*]Multiplayer Compatible: Works great in co-op mode!
[*]Controller Compatible: Players can navigate and click buttons in the menu using controller.
[*]Android Compatible: This mod works identically on Android as on PC.
[/list][size=6]How to Use[/size][list=1]
[*]Open any chest.
[*]Click the "Set Label" button located above the chest inventory.
[*]Type your desired name in the pop-up menu and click the OK (Checkmark) button.
[*]To remove a label, simply click the "clear" button.
[*]You can easily config label style in the config menu.
[/list][size=6]Supported Languages[/size]
This mod is fully localized and supports all 12 official game languages
[list]
[*]English
[*]Chinese (中文)
[*]German (Deutsch)
[*]Spanish (Español)
[*]French (Français)
[*]Hungarian (Magyar)
[*]Italian (Italiano)
[*]Japanese (日本語)
[*]Korean (한국어)
[*]Portuguese (Português)
[*]Russian (Русский)
[*]Turkish (Türkçe)
[/list][size=6]Installation[/size][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
